title: Taste prototype: Beta chips in Settings (appearance.settingsBetaChips, off by default): experimental rows and the Experimental sidebar entry get a small Beta chip

steps.title: Settings > Experimental, opt-in off: the page as today, no chips
Turn the opt-in on: cmux settings set appearance.settingsBetaChips true
On: each experimental row's title and the Experimental sidebar entry carry a Beta chip
steps.optional: Settings may open on another row

steps.title: An everyday page: no row chip; only the Experimental sidebar entry keeps one
steps.optional: Settings may open on another section

steps.title: Off again: the chips go away
